方向上，Hold 持仓得到了验证，因为预先承诺拒绝在 83,000–83,100 追多，避免了 -2.6% 的跌幅；尽管 alpha vs SPY 再次显示为 +nan%——基准收盘价没有被记录，这恰恰是该报告本身指出的失败之处。看空的短期情况得到了证实：13 天的负 MACD 柱状图和 10.4B 的无需求反弹先于下滑出现，跌破了 81,750 的警报，并将价格推至约 80,950——距离 80,930 50-SMA 减仓线不到 20 美元——因此中期结构得以维持，但只是勉强维持，而非依靠安全边际。教训：不再将噪音范围内的警报水平视为“洗盘诱饵”（81,750 恰如路径风险论点所警告的那样被扫过），而是预先承诺在每个水平进行机械化响应，并在决策时记录 SPY 收盘价，以便最终能计算出 alpha。

[2026-10-10 | BTC-USD | Hold | -0.9%]
The Hold call was directionally correct: -0.9% raw return left price inside the pre-committed 80,337–84,367 dead zone with neither trigger firing, and alpha remains +NaN% because the SPY benchmark is still missing — the exact failure mode prior reviews flagged and this decision explicitly promised to fix. The thesis held where it mattered (trend intact above the 50-day, no breakdown, so no forced exit) and the refusal to add without MACD/price/macro confirmation was vindicated by the drift lower, not refuted by it. Lesson: attach the benchmark close at decision time and expiry so every Hold gets a computable alpha, and evaluate Holds by whether a pre-committed trigger fired within the window rather than by terminal return, which is uninformative for neutral calls.
